page_title: COM 0-2 FIO | Como v Fiorentina 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Alberto Moreno (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.
90+2' Alberto Dossena (Como) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) takes the corner with a short pass.
88' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Alberto Dossena (Como).

87' Great chance! Andrea Belotti (Como) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
86' That's the end of the game for Lucas Da Cunha, who is replaced by Matthias Braunoder (Como).

86' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Emil Audero leaps like a salmon to deny him.
84' A neat pass is well received by Simone Verdi (Como), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
83' Wow, what an escape. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
82' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
81' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) replacing Luca Ranieri.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dodo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina).
80' The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick. Patrick Cutrone (Como) attempts to find Andrea Belotti, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

79' Nico Paz (Como) expertly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
79' It's time for a substitution. Andrea Belotti (Como) comes on in place of Alieu Fadera.
79' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Yannik Engelhardt and he is replaced by Simone Verdi (Como).
78' Substitution. Federico Barba is replaced by Fellipe Jack (Como).
77' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
75' The game is interrupted now, Alberto Dossena (Como) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

74' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Patrick Cutrone (Como) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.

71' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
68' 0 - 2 Goal! Riccardo Sottil tees up Moise Kean (Fiorentina) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the top left corner. 0:2.
66' Here is a change. Lucas Beltran is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
66' Substitution. Andrea Colpani did his best and is replaced by Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina).
64' Alieu Fadera (Como) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
63' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
62' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Robin Gosens (Fiorentina). Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
62' David de Gea (Fiorentina) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

61' Federico Barba (Como) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. David de Gea pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going low into the middle of the target.

60' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick low shot towards the middle of the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows David de Gea to make a comfortable save.
59' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
59' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The ball is out of play. Como win a corner kick.
58' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
57' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Nico Paz (Como) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Fiorentina.
56' We are about to witness a subsitution. Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) for Danilo Cataldi.
54' Alberto Moreno (Como) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
52' Alessio Iovine (Como) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Fiorentina are awarded the free kick.
51' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina. Alberto Moreno (Como) tries to find Alieu Fadera, but he puts too much power on the pass.
49' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. That's a free kick to Como.

48' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marchetti with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Fiorentina.
46' Half-time substitution. Cesc Fabregas decided to make a change. Marco Sala (Como) is replaced by Alessio Iovine.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+2' Patrick Cutrone (Como) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Nico Paz (Como) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.

39' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Moise Kean (Fiorentina) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
38' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
35' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.

31' Federico Barba (Como) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
31' Como take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

31' Alberto Moreno (Como) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Como are awarded a corner kick.
30' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emil Audero, who smothers the ball.
30' Dodo (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is behind the touchline and Fiorentina will take a throw-in.
29' Matteo Marchetti shows the yellow card to Nico Paz (Como) for a heavy challenge.
28' The total number of attempts is 1:1.
23' Alieu Fadera (Como) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Alieu Fadera (Como) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul. Fiorentina have a free kick.
19' 0 - 1 Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) latches on to a brilliant pass and hits a poor shot towards the middle of the goal, but the ball goes into the back of the net after the goalkeeper makes a howler!
19' Neat link-up play between Alieu Fadera (Como) and Patrick Cutrone, but David de Gea reads the game well and the move breaks down.
18' David de Gea pulls off a great save to deny Patrick Cutrone (Como) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
15' Nico Paz (Como) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
12' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
10' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
9' The corner from Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) is intercepted by the defence. Fiorentina will take a corner kick.
5' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and it's Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Como have a free kick.
5' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
2' Flag goes up against Moise Kean (Fiorentina) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti will supervise the game today.
